safety_verdicts.content: Patient has needed to use the blue inhaler twice a day.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies current blue inhaler use up to twice daily; generated facts state salbutamol PRN/no relief but do not document the twice-daily frequency.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient is currently using the reliever twice daily can understate symptom burden and asthma control, which may affect urgency of review and step-up decisions. This is clinically relevant in an asthma exacerbation context but is unlikely by itself to directly cause major harm.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold includes the specific maintenance dose (Clenil 2 puffs twice daily). Generated notes Clenil daily but does not capture the 2 puffs BID baseline.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the baseline preventer dose (Clenil 2 puffs BID) reduces clarity on the patient’s usual controller therapy and makes it harder to judge appropriate temporary dose escalation or adherence. This could lead to suboptimal management but typically results in additional monitoring or adjustment rather than severe injury.
